home.heroText: Get alerts when someone goes missing near you, and report it if you see them. Every sighting helps.
home.whoText: Check their photo against missing-person reports.
home.noCases: ✅ Connected. No active cases right now.
home.togetherText: Lumen works because people help each other. Turn on alerts and share posters: you could be the one who brings someone home.

alerts.title: 🔔 Alerts near you
alerts.onPush: ✅ On: notifications. You’ll be alerted if someone goes missing near you.
alerts.onSms: ✅ On: SMS. You’ll be alerted if someone goes missing near you.
alerts.addPhone: Add your mobile number in <link>Profile</link> to receive SMS alerts.
alerts.intro: Get a notification when someone goes missing within a few km of you. Your exact location is never shown to anyone.
alerts.offDone: Alerts are off on this phone.

msg.noLocation: Please allow location access. Alerts are only sent for people missing near you.
msg.blocked: Notifications are blocked or not supported on this phone. Log in and add your mobile number to get SMS alerts instead.
msg.onPush: Alerts are ON. You’ll get a notification if someone goes missing near you.
msg.onSms: Notifications are blocked, so you’ll get SMS alerts on the number in your profile.

case.emergency: In an emergency, call the police on <link>112</link>.

report.thankText: Your sighting has been sent to the police. If you can safely stay nearby, please do. In an emergency, call <link>112</link>.
report.noActive: There are no active missing-person cases right now.
report.title: Report a sighting
report.detailsPlaceholder: What were they wearing? Were they with anyone? Which direction did they go?
report.photo: Photo (only if it’s safe to take one)
report.errNoPoint: Please mark on the map where you saw the person.
report.errTime: Please enter a time that is not in the future.
report.savedOffline: No internet right now. Your report is saved on this phone and will be sent by itself as soon as you're back online.

picker.noGeo: This phone/browser cannot share location. Tap the map instead.
picker.denied: Location permission was denied. Tap the map to choose the spot instead.
picker.failed: Could not get your location. Tap the map to choose the spot instead.
picker.pinAt: Pin at {{lat}}, {{lng}}. Tap the map to move it.
picker.tapHint: Tap the map to choose the spot.

poster.shareText: MISSING: {{name}}. Last seen: {{place}}. Seen them? Report here: {{url}}
poster.downloaded: Poster downloaded and link copied. Share it on WhatsApp.
poster.failed: Could not make the poster. Please try again.

reunited.title: {{name}} has been found
reunited.thanks: Thank you to everyone who shared, looked out and reported. Alerts for this case have stopped.

found.title: Found someone who seems lost?
found.intro: Register a lost child or adult you have found. Our AI compares their photo with every missing person, and police are told if it may be them. Only you and the police can see the photo.
found.emergencyTip: If they are in danger, call 112 first.
found.detailsPlaceholder: What are they wearing? What did they say? Anything that could help identify them.
found.thanks: Thank you. The AI is checking the photo now (1–2 minutes). The police can see your report.
found.errPhoto: Please add a photo of their face.
found.noFace: No clear face in the photo. Police can still see your report.
found.noMatch: No match yet. We keep checking as new cases are added.

safety.rowText: QR card for a child or elder
safety.title: QR safety card
safety.intro: Make a card for a child or an elderly person. If they get lost, anyone who scans the QR code can call you straight away, with no app needed.
safety.name: Their name *
safety.note: Note: language they speak, medical needs…
safety.privacy: Nothing is saved on our servers. The details live only inside the QR code.
safety.errRequired: Please enter their name and a valid phone number.
safety.cardScan: If I am lost, please scan

sos.title: I may be lost. Please help me.
sos.stay: Please stay with me in a safe, public place until my family or the police arrive.
sos.invalid: This safety card link is not valid.
